sense: an organized effort to win votes or support

evidence: Cic. Att. 1.1.1: prēnsat ūnus P. Galba
Traupman 180: manūs prēnsāre, shake hands when campaigning
Cic. Tusc. 2.62: quid dē nostrīs ambitiōnibus loquar? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lawful canvassing; ambitus is the unlawful kind.
Not a campaign but the crime, as in lēx dē ambitū.

phrases.latin: petītiōnis nostrae, quam tibi summae cūrae esse sciō, hujus modī ratiō est, quod adhūc conjectūrā prōvidērī possit. prēnsat ūnus P. Galba
phrases.english: as for my campaign, which I know matters a great deal to you, this is how it stands, as far as one can guess so far: only Publius Galba is canvassing
